For our client in Meer, we are looking for a maintenance technician.

• As a maintenance technician, you are responsible for repairing technical malfunctions in the production machines.
• The issues can be both electrical and mechanical, but the majority are industrial electrical faults. You are responsible for identifying the malfunction and resolving it.
• In addition, you carry out equipment overhauls.
• You ensure that operators and production staff can continue working at all times.
• Preventive and major maintenance tasks are carried out on Saturdays.
• Furthermore, you make suggestions to optimize the process and proactively prevent malfunctions.Profiel
• You hold an A2 diploma in electromechanics or industrial electricity, or equivalent through experience
• You are very proficient in reading electrical diagrams
• You are willing to work in a pig slaughterhouse (you are not required to do any slaughtering yourself, only to maintain the machines)
• You have a good command of Dutch or English
• You are willing to work in a shift system. In addition, you will work on Saturdays and can take a compensatory day off during the week (not on Monday or Friday)
• Knowledge of PLCs and/or I/O configuration (not programming) is a plus
• You are flexible with working hours and can work both independently and in a team
• You are willing to work in varying temperature conditionsWat je van ons krijgt
• Possibility of a permanent contract after a successful interim period
• Additional training can be provided. You will be guided by an experienced technician at the start
• Your salary is negotiable and depends on your experience and knowledge. This is supplemented with extra-legal benefits including meal vouchers. You also have the option to work overtime, with the choice of taking extra days off or receiving payment for the extra hours
• You will work in a family-oriented environment with a flat organizational structure. There is a strong and collegial atmosphere among colleagues
• Safety, hygiene, and the well-being of people and animals are taken very seriously here.

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an established investment management organisation based in Brussels, operating in an international and highly regulated environment. The offices are easily accessible and offer the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders on strategic compliance matters.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the compliance and risk framework
• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of new regulatory requirements
• Oversee AML/CFT activities and participate in related control and reporting processes
• Support interactions with regulators, supervisory authorities and regulatory filings
• Assess and monitor outsourced service providers and ICT-related risks
• Provide compliance support across fund operations, including investment monitoring and conflict assessments
• Participate in regulatory analyses supporting new jurisdictions, fundraising activities and cross-border operations

• Master's degree in Law, Finance or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Compliance position
• Experience within an AIFM, investment fund, private equity, venture capital, asset management or another regulated financial services organisation
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are valuable assets
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, compliance controls and risk management practices
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with multiple internal and external stakeholders

Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.

• First relevant experience in Retail or a Field Sales experience is expected

• Presentation and communication skills

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

• Previous management experience is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Medical Sales - Pharma Rx - Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a pharmaceutical company specializing in hormone therapies for women's and men's health. They develop and manufacture treatments for menopause, fertility, reproductive health, and testosterone deficiency. With operations in around 100 countries and a strong presence in Belgium, the company is recognized as a global leader in hormone-based medicines. Its expertise in trans dermal gel technologies has made several of its products widely used worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Medical Representative - Pharma Rx - Women health - Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Drive sales growth and increase market share for Women health products within the hospitals & private cabinets in Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant. 
• Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals, including gynecologists, urologists, endocrinologists, and other key stakeholders.
• Identify new business opportunities and expand product adoption among existing and prospective customers.
• Promote Women Health RX products awareness through participation in scientific meetings, congresses, exhibitions, and educational events.
• Collaborate with Key Opinion Leaders (Gynecologists, urologists & endocrinologists) to support training initiatives and strengthen disease and product awareness. 
• Maintain accurate CRM records and manage activities efficiently within budget.

As a successful Medical Representative - Pharma Rx - Women health - Antwerp, Limburg & Flemish Brabant, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Degree in Science, Healthcare, Business, or a related field
• +3 years of experiences as Medical Representative selling Rx (products under prescription) 
• Strong understanding of the women's and men's health market and its key stakeholders is an asset 
• Strong communication & interpersonal skills 
• Strong commercial & negotiation skills 
• Fluent in Dutch & English
